lots.guide_summary: All sold. Close Gowans bundle hammers run $80 to $100 (6 sales opened, last 13 months), with the nearest match (boxed Wii Sports pack plus boxed Wii Fit Plus) at $80 in Oct 2026. The boxed Super Mario 25th set adds about A$51 to A$68 on its own (3 eBay sales via PriceCharting, USD at 1.52). One eBay AU ask at about A$70 is a snippet-only lead. No unsold entries. Realistic value for the whole lot is about $90 to $150.
lots.working: Keep: lowest surviving close SOLD is the $80 Gowans boxed Wii plus Wii Fit Plus (443869, also 369216 at $80). $80 / 1.22 = $65.57, rounded down to $65 (all-in $79.30). Flip: sell split. Wii bundle at a local auction about $90 (median of close Gowans sales) less 15% seller commission = $76.50; 25th set on eBay about A$59 less 13% fees ($7.70) and $12 postage = $39.30. Net resale $115.80 / 2.44 = $47.46, rounded down to $45. Pickup from Invermay, inbound freight $0.
lots.confidence_reason: Box labels read clearly (Wii Sports pack, Wii Fit Plus, Mario Kart Wii, Super Mario All-Stars 25th Anniversary PAL G rated) and several opened Tasmanian sales match closely, but the lot is untested, cables and sensor bar are not visible, and the comparables are bundles, not identical.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the eBay.de AU$102.50 entry (snippet only, sale status unconfirmed, URL match uncertain, eBay closed to us). Category range corrected: the researcher's $40 to $160 band is broadly right but the typical close bundle is $65 to $100. Gowans 443062-style mis-titles not relevant here. Added PriceCharting sold data for the 25th set. WebSearch session cap was hit, so no Armitage past results could be searched.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: boxed white Wii (Wii Sports pack), boxed Wii Fit Plus with board pictured, Mario Kart Wii wheel box, red 25th Anniversary box, loose remote with cord, black and blue remote jackets, two battery packs. Photo 2: game cases for Mario & Sonic London 2012, Avatar (PG, PAL), Captain America, Wii Sports, Chicken Blaster, House of the Dead Overkill (MA15+, $10 off sticker). Photo 3: Super Mario All-Stars 25th Anniversary Edition PAL box, G rated, contents listed as Wii disc, booklet and soundtrack CD; box corners lightly worn, small tear at bottom edge. Not seen: console itself, sensor bar, power pack, AV cable, discs, wheel.
lots.condition: Boxes look sound with light shelf wear; 25th set box has a small edge tear. Untested, contents of boxes not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Are the Wii console and Wii Fit Plus board actually inside their boxes, with sensor bar, power pack and AV cable? Is the Mario Kart wheel inside its box? Is the Super Mario 25th set complete (disc, booklet, soundtrack CD)? Are all six game discs in their cases? Has the console been powered up?

lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: full height piece, roughly 2m tall, central mirror flanked by narrow mirrored side panels with bobbin spindles, carved roundels and foliate panels, curved bobbin-turned side rails forming umbrella galleries. Photo 3: crest with carved rosette, moulded cornice, carved floral frieze. Photo 4: hand-forged scroll iron hooks. Photo 5: drawer open, lined with yellow Provencal-print fabric, top shows wear and minor marks. Machine-even carving and the fabric lining suggest mid 20th century French production. No labels seen.
lots.condition: Appears structurally complete with all hooks; top surface worn with light marks; mirror glass looks clear. Back and joints not shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: What are the height and width, does it come apart for transport, is there any maker's label or stamp, are the mirrors original and clear, and are there any loose joints, worm or broken spindles?
